argument.script: async (intermediate) => { const listId = '{{ list_id }}'; const username = '{{ username }}'.replace(/^@/, ''); const ct0 = document.cookie.split(';').map(c=>c.trim()).find(c=>c.startsWith('ct0='))?.split('=')[1]; if (!ct0) return { error: 'Not logged into x.com' }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000)); const moreBtn = document.querySelector('[data-testid="userActions"]'); if (!moreBtn) return { ok: false, message: 'User actions button not found' }; moreBtn.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const listMenuItem = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitem"]')).find(m => /list/i.test(m.textContent || '') && /add|remove/i.test(m.textContent || '')); if (!listMenuItem) return { ok: false, message: 'Add/Remove from Lists menu not found' }; listMenuItem.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); const dialog = document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'); if (!dialog) return { ok: false, message: 'Lists dialog not found' }; const listCells = dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="listCell"]'); let targetCell = null; for (const cell of listCells) { if (cell.textContent?.includes(listId)) { targetCell = cell; break; } } if (!targetCell) return { ok: false, message: 'List ' + listId + ' not found in dialog' }; const checked = targetCell.querySelector('[role="checkbox"]')?.getAttribute('aria-checked'); if (checked === 'true') return { ok: true, message: 'Already in list' }; targetCell.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const saveBtn = dialog.querySelector('[role="button"]'); const saveBtns = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('[role="button"]')); const done = saveBtns.find(b => /save|done/i.test(b.textContent || '')); if (done) { done.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); } const closeBtn = dialog.querySelector('[data-testid="app-bar-close"]'); if (closeBtn) closeBtn.click(); return { ok: true, message: 'Added to list', listId, username }; }
async (intermediate) => { if (intermediate.error) return [{ ok: false, message: intermediate.error }]; return [intermediate]; }

description: Add a user to a Twitter/X list
name: ListAdd
